description: A serverside Fabric mod that (kinda) restores Alloy Forgery's Forge Controller GUI when using it with PolyMC.

mods.name: PolyForgery
mods.description: GUI polyfill for Alloy Forgery with PolyMC API.

releases.notes:
Hello!
First of all, thanks to @unilock for the port and all of the improvements mentioned above.
This update targets the to-be-released version 5.7.0 of PolyMc for Minecraft 1.21.1.

The new changes (by @unilock) include:
- Texture compression with oxipng
- Readded and improved Polydex support
  - Now you will be able to see yields for different Forge tiers (eg. iron yield with T1 vs. T3)
- Code improvements and bug fixes

Also since serverside modding is becoming mainstream, starting **this version** _(once PolyMc 5.7.0 fully releases)_ this mod will be available on Modrinth!
